035/**
036 * The Alloy backend of the solution loop, for a temporal model: claferIG's
037 * {@code ClaferIG.hs}, and its commands of {@code CommandLine.hs}, on an
038 * {@link AlloySession} in this JVM. The model is translated by the
039 * frontend's port of the compiler's AlloyLtl generator, with {@code -k}, as
040 * claferIG has the compiler translate it; the code is given to Alloy in
041 * memory.
042 */
043public final class AlloyBackend implements Backend {
044
045    /**
046     * What claferIG takes from its command line.
047     *
048     * @param bitwidth {@code --bitwidth}, 4 by default
049     * @param useUids {@code --useuids}
050     * @param addTypes {@code --addtypes}
051     */
052    public record Options(int bitwidth, boolean useUids, boolean addTypes) {
053
054        public static final Options Default = new Options(4, false, false);
055    }
056

061    @FunctionalInterface

064        ToIr.Result load() throws Exception;
065    }

072    private ToIr.Result ir;
073    private AlloyGenerator.Translation translation;
074    private List<Constraint> constraints;
075    private AlloyXml.Naming naming;
076    private Map<String, String> alloyNames;
077    private Map<String, String> uids;
078    private Map<String, ClaferInfo> claferInfos;
079    private Set<String> emptySigs;
080    private Map<String, List<String>> paths;
081    private int bitwidth;
082    private boolean dynamic;
083    // AlloyIGInterface's AlloyIGEnv
084    private final Map<String, AlloySession.SigInfo> sigMap = new TreeMap<>();
085    private final Map<String, Integer> scopes = new TreeMap<>();
086    private int globalScope;

088    /**
089     * Loads the model, as claferIG's {@code load} does.
090     *
091     * @param modelFileName the name of the model's file, which names the
092     * saved files
093     */
094    public AlloyBackend(Loader loader, String modelFileName, Options options) throws Exception {
095        this.loader = loader;
096        this.modelFileName = modelFileName;
097        this.options = options;
098        this.bitwidth = options.bitwidth();
099        load();
100    }
101
102    private void load() throws Exception {
103        ir = loader.load();
104        translation = AlloyGenerator.translate(ir.model(), ir.scopes().orElseThrow().clafers(),
105                ir.model().options().traceLength().orElse(10));
106        // the integer range of the options (--maxint, --minint) raises the bitwidth
107        int bw = bitwidth;
108        var o = ir.files().options();
109        if (o.maxInt().isPresent()) {
110            bw = Math.max(bw, requiredBitwidth(o.maxInt().getAsLong()));
111        }
112        if (o.minInt().isPresent()) {
113            bw = Math.max(bw, requiredBitwidth(-o.minInt().getAsLong() - 1));
114        }
115        alloyNames = new HashMap<>(translation.alloyNames());
116        uids = new HashMap<>();
117        alloyNames.forEach((u, a) -> uids.put(a, u));
118        claferInfos = new HashMap<>();
119        Map<String, AlloyXml.ClaferInfo> namingInfos = new HashMap<>();
120        paths = new LinkedHashMap<>();
121        for (ClaferSymbol c : ir.names().clafers()) {
122            String a = alloyName(c.uid());
123            var card = c.card();
124            claferInfos.put(a, new ClaferInfo(c.name(), new Constraints.Cardinality(card.low(), card.high())));
125            String reference = c.reference().flatMap(r -> r.primitive()).orElse(null);
126            namingInfos.put(a, new AlloyXml.ClaferInfo(c.name(),
127                    c.superClafer().map(s -> alloyName(s.uid())).orElse(null), reference));
128            List<String> path = new ArrayList<>();
129            for (Optional<ClaferSymbol> p = Optional.of(c); p.isPresent(); p = p.get().parent()) {
130                path.add(0, p.get().name());
131            }
132            paths.put(c.uid(), path);
133        }
134        naming = new AlloyXml.Naming(namingInfos, this::toUid, options.useUids(), options.addTypes(),
135                translation.strings());
136        constraints = Constraints.parseConstraints(ir.files(), claferInfos, translation.mapping());
137        emptySigs = new HashSet<>();
138        ir.scopes().orElseThrow().clafers().forEach((u, s) -> {
139            if (s == 0) {
140                emptySigs.add("this/" + alloyName(u));
141            }
142        });
143        AlloySession.Loaded loaded = session.load(translation.code());
144        dynamic = session.isDynamic();
145        sigMap.clear();
146        scopes.clear();
147        loaded.sigs().forEach(s -> sigMap.put(s.label(), s));
148        globalScope = loaded.globalScope();
149        for (AlloySession.SigInfo s : sigMap.values()) {
150            setScopeCommand(s.label(), s.startingScope().orElse(1));
151        }
152        setBitwidth(bw);
153    }
154
155    private String alloyName(String uid) {
156        return alloyNames.getOrDefault(uid, uid);
157    }
158
159    private String toUid(String alloyName) {
160        return uids.getOrDefault(alloyName, alloyName);
161    }

163    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
164    // AlloyIGInterface
165    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
166    private static boolean withinRange(int scope, String multiplicity) {
167        return switch (multiplicity) {
168            case "One" -> scope == 1;
169            case "Lone" -> scope == 0 || scope == 1;
170            case "Some" -> scope >= 1;
171            default -> true;
172        };
173    }
174
175    // sendSetScopeCommand: the subset sig, if it is one, whose scope is not set
176    private Optional<String> setScopeCommand(String sig, int scope) throws Err {
177        AlloySession.SigInfo info = sigMap.get(sig);
178        if (!info.subset().isEmpty()) {
179            return Optional.of(info.subset());
180        }
181        if (withinRange(scope, info.multiplicity())) {
182            session.setScope(sig, scope);
183        }
184        scopes.put(sig, scope);
185        return Optional.empty();
186    }
187
188    private int valueOfScope(String sig) {
189        return scopes.getOrDefault(sig, globalScope);
190    }
191
192    private void setGlobalScope(int scope) {
193        session.setGlobalScope(scope);
194        globalScope = scope;
195    }
196
197    private void setBitwidth(int bw) {
198        bitwidth = bw;
199        session.setBitwidth(bw);
200    }

205    private boolean hasNoInstances(String sig) {
206        return emptySigs.contains(sig);
207    }
208
209    // setAlloyScope: the clafer's name of the subset sig, if it is one
210    private Optional<String> setAlloyScope(int value, String sig) throws Err {
211        return setScopeCommand(sig, hasNoInstances(sig) ? 0 : value).map(this::claferNameOfSig);
212    }
213
214    private String claferNameOfSig(String sig) {
215        String name = sig.startsWith("this/") ? sig.substring(5) : sig;
216        AlloyXml.ClaferInfo info = naming.clafers().get(name);
217        return info == null ? name : info.ident();
218    }

228    /**
229     * {@code getUIDs}: the clafers that a name names.
230     */
231    private List<String> getUIDs(String qName) {
232        if (paths.containsKey(qName)) {
233            return List.of(qName);
234        }
235        boolean fromRoot;
236        List<String> names;
237        if (qName.startsWith("::")) {
238            fromRoot = true;
239            names = List.of(qName.substring(2).split("::", -1));
240        } else if (qName.contains("::")) {
241            fromRoot = false;
242            names = List.of(qName.split("::", -1));
243        } else {
244            List<String> parts = List.of(qName.split("__", -1));
245            if (parts.size() > 1 && parts.get(0).equals("root")) {
246                fromRoot = true;
247                names = parts.subList(1, parts.size());
248            } else {
249                fromRoot = false;
250                names = parts;
251            }
252        }
253        if (names.isEmpty() || qName.isEmpty()) {
254            return List.of();
255        }
256        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
257        paths.forEach((uid, path) -> {
258            if (fromRoot ? path.equals(names)
259                    : path.size() >= names.size() && path.subList(path.size() - names.size(), path.size()).equals(names)) {
260                out.add(uid);
261            }
262        });
263        return out;
264    }

270    private Shown shown(Optional<String> xml) {

273
274    private List<Optional<Constraint>> findRemovable(List<int[]> core) {
275        Set<String> absIDs = new HashSet<>();
276        for (ClaferSymbol c : ir.names().clafers()) {
277            if (c.isAbstract()) {
278                absIDs.add(c.name());
279            }
280        }
281        List<Optional<Constraint>> out = new ArrayList<>();
282        for (int[] c : core) {
283            Range r = new Range(c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]);
284            Optional<Constraint> found = constraints.stream().filter(k -> k.range().equals(r)).findFirst();
285            if (found.isPresent() && found.get() instanceof UpperCardinalityConstraint u
286                    && u.claferInfo().cardinality().lower() == 0 && u.claferInfo().cardinality().upper() == 0
287                    && absIDs.contains(u.claferInfo().uniqueId())) {
288                continue;
289            }
290            out.add(found);
291        }
292        return out;
293    }
294
295    private static Optional<Constraint> first(List<Optional<Constraint>> cs) {
296        return cs.stream().filter(Optional::isPresent).map(Optional::get).findFirst();
297    }
298
299    private static List<Constraint> present(List<Optional<Constraint>> cs) {
300        return cs.stream().filter(Optional::isPresent).map(Optional::get).toList();
301    }
302
303    /**
304     * {@code next}: the next solution, or the unsat core of the model with a
305     * near-miss, or none.
306     */
307    @Override
308    public Shown next(Repl.Io io) throws Exception {
309        Optional<String> xml = session.next();
310        if (xml.isPresent()) {
311            return shown(xml);
312        }
313        session.saveState();
314        // Generating counterexample modifies the state. If we ever want to
315        // rerun the original model, we need to restore the state.
316        List<int[]> core = session.unsatCore();
317        List<Constraint> removed = new ArrayList<>();
318        List<Constraint> unsatCore = null;
319        Shown nearMiss = null;
320        while (true) {
321            Optional<Constraint> remove = first(findRemovable(core));
322            if (remove.isEmpty()) {
323                // It is possible that none of the constraints are removable
324                break;
325            }
326            Range r = remove.get().range();
327            session.removeConstraint((int) r.line(), (int) r.column(), (int) r.endLine(), (int) r.endColumn());
328            session.resolve();
329            Optional<String> near = session.next();
330            removed.add(remove.get());
331            if (near.isPresent()) {
332                unsatCore = present(findRemovable(core));
333                nearMiss = shown(near);
334                break;
335            }
336            core = session.unsatCore();
337        }
338        session.restoreState();
339        if (unsatCore == null) {
340            io.err().println(dynamic
341                    ? "No more traces found. Try increasing the scopes or the maximum trace length ('tl') to get more traces (type 'h' for help)."
342                    : "No more instances found. Try increasing the scopes to get more instances (type 'h' for help).");
343            return null;
344        }
345        io.err().println("No instances found.");
346        io.err().println("The following set of constraints cannot be satisfied in the current scope.");
347        io.err().println("Consider removing one of the constraints from the model.");
348        io.err().println("Use the setUnsatCoreMinimization command to minimize the set of constraints below.");
349        io.err().println("Try increasing the scopes to get an instance (type 'h' for help).");
350        int i = 1;
351        for (Constraint c : unsatCore) {
352            io.err().println("  " + i++ + ") " + printConstraint(c));
353        }
354        io.err().println("Altering the following constraints produced the following near-miss example:");
355        printTransformations(io, removed);
356        io.err().flush();
357        io.out().println(SolutionView.solutionText(nearMiss.solution()));
358        return null;
359    }
360
361    private static String printConstraint(Constraint c) {
362        return switch (c) {
363            case UserConstraint u -> u.constraintInfo().toString();
364            case ExactCardinalityConstraint e -> e.claferInfo().toString();
365            case LowerCardinalityConstraint l -> l.claferInfo().toString();
366            case UpperCardinalityConstraint u -> u.claferInfo().toString();
367        };
368    }
369
370    private static ClaferInfo withCard(ClaferInfo info, long lower, long upper) {
371        return new ClaferInfo(info.uniqueId(), new Constraints.Cardinality(lower, upper));
372    }
373
374    private void printTransformations(Repl.Io io, List<Constraint> cs) {
375        List<Constraint> rest = new ArrayList<>(cs);
376        int i = 1;
377        while (!rest.isEmpty()) {
378            Constraint c = rest.remove(0);
379            String text = switch (c) {
380                case UserConstraint u -> "removed " + u.constraintInfo().syntax();
381                case ExactCardinalityConstraint e -> e.claferInfo() + " changed to " + withCard(e.claferInfo(), 0, -1);
382                case LowerCardinalityConstraint l -> {
383                    ClaferInfo info = l.claferInfo();
384                    // Deleted the lower and upper constraint, or only the lower one
385                    yield deleteOther(rest, info, UpperCardinalityConstraint.class)
386                            ? info + " changed to " + withCard(info, 0, -1)
387                            : info + " changed to " + withCard(info, 0, info.cardinality().upper());
388                }
389                case UpperCardinalityConstraint u -> {
390                    ClaferInfo info = u.claferInfo();
391                    yield deleteOther(rest, info, LowerCardinalityConstraint.class)
392                            ? info + " changed to " + withCard(info, 0, -1)
393                            : info + " changed to " + withCard(info, info.cardinality().lower(), -1);
394                }
395            };
396            io.err().println("  " + i++ + ") " + text);
397        }
398    }
399
400    // findAndDelete in the cardinality constraints of the other kind: the rest without the first one of the
401    // same clafer, if any (the rest keeps only that kind, as the compiler's filter gives it)
402    private static boolean deleteOther(List<Constraint> rest, ClaferInfo info, Class<?> kind) {
403        List<Constraint> ofKind = rest.stream().filter(kind::isInstance).toList();
404        for (int i = 0; i < ofKind.size(); i++) {
405            ClaferInfo other = ofKind.get(i) instanceof LowerCardinalityConstraint l ? l.claferInfo()
406                    : ((UpperCardinalityConstraint) ofKind.get(i)).claferInfo();
407            if (other.uniqueId().equals(info.uniqueId())) {
408                List<Constraint> left = new ArrayList<>(ofKind);
409                left.remove(i);
410                rest.clear();
411                rest.addAll(left);
412                return true;
413            }
414        }
415        return false;
416    }

436    @Override
437    public void check(Repl.Io io, Integer line, Repl.Displayer display) throws Exception {
438        List<String[]> assertions = new ArrayList<>();
439        List<ConstraintInfo> infos = new ArrayList<>();
440        List<String> text = Constraints.text(ir.files());
441        for (AlloyGenerator.Assertion a : translation.assertions()) {
442            ConstraintInfo info = Constraints.constraintInfoOf(ir.files(), text, a.span());
443            if (line == null || info.isOnLine(line)) {
444                assertions.add(new String[]{a.name()});
445                infos.add(info);
446            }
447        }
448        if (assertions.isEmpty()) {
449            io.out().println(line == null ? "The model has no assertions."
450                    : "The model has no assertion on line " + line + ".");
451            return;
452        }
453        int failed = 0;
454        for (int i = 0; i < assertions.size(); i++) {
455            Optional<String> xml = session.check(assertions.get(i)[0]);
456            if (xml.isEmpty()) {
457                io.out().println("No counterexample: " + infos.get(i));
458            } else {
459                io.out().println("Counterexample of: " + infos.get(i));
460                display.display(new Shown(toSolution(xml.get()), xml.get()));
461                failed++;
462            }
463        }
464        String bounds = dynamic ? "the scopes and the maximum trace length" : "the scopes";
465        io.out().println(assertions.size() + " assertion(s) checked within " + bounds + ": " + failed
466                + " with a counterexample.");
467    }

469    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
470    // the commands of CommandLine.hs
471    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
472    /**
473     * The bitwidth required to store the given integer.
474     */
475    static int requiredBitwidth(long n) {
476        return (int) Math.ceil(Math.log(2.0 * n + 1) / Math.log(2));
477    }
478
479    /**
480     * The largest integer allowed by the given bitwidth.
481     */
482    static long allowedMaxInt(int bw) {
483        return (1L << (bw - 1)) - 1;
484    }
485
486    private static long allowedMinInt(int bw) {
487        return -(allowedMaxInt(bw) + 1);
488    }
489
490    private void printBitwidthIntRange(Repl.Io io, int bw) {
491        io.out().println("Integer range = " + allowedMinInt(bw) + ".." + allowedMaxInt(bw) + " (bitwidth = " + bw
492                + ")");
493    }
494
495    private void printBitwidthWarning(Repl.Io io, int bw) {
496        if (bw > 9) {
497            io.out().println("Warning! This is a very large bitwidth for Alloy, which may cause slow down.");
498        }
499    }
500
501    /**
502     * {@code findNecessaryBitwidth}.
503     */
504    private int findNecessaryBitwidth(int oldBw, List<Integer> scopeValues) {
505        long max = Math.max(scopeValues.stream().mapToLong(Integer::longValue).max().orElse(0), translation.maxInt());
506        int newBw = (int) Math.ceil(Math.log(2.0 * max + 1) / Math.log(2));
507        return Math.max(newBw, oldBw);
508    }
509
510    private void solve() throws Err {
511        session.resolve();
512    }

515    public void start(Repl.Io io) throws Exception {

517        prepare();
518        io.out().println("Type 'h' for the list of available REPL commands\n");
519    }

521    /**
522     * Sets the bitwidth that the scopes need and solves the model, as
523     * {@link #start} does without its messages: before the first
524     * {@link #next}.
525     */
526    public void prepare() throws Exception {
527        setBitwidth(findNecessaryBitwidth(bitwidth, new ArrayList<>(scopes.values())));
528        solve();
529    }

571    private static Integer integer(String s) {
572        try {
573            return Integer.valueOf(s);
574        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
575            return null;
576        }
577    }
578
579    private static Integer natural(String s) {
580        Integer n = integer(s);
581        return n != null && n >= 0 && !s.startsWith("+") && !s.startsWith("-") ? n : null;
582    }
583
584    @Override
585    public boolean command(Repl.Io io, String input, List<String> words, Repl.Context context) throws Exception {
586        String name = words.isEmpty() ? "" : words.get(0);
587        int arity = words.size() - 1;
588        switch (name) {
589            case "S", "SetGlobalScope" -> {
590                Integer n = arity == 1 ? natural(words.get(1)) : null;
591                if (n == null) {
592                    io.out().println("The format of the command is: 'S <integer>'");
593                    return true;
594                }
595                setGlobalScopeCommand(io, n);
596            }
597            case "I", "IncGlobalScope" -> {
598                Integer n = arity == 0 ? Integer.valueOf(1) : arity == 1 ? integer(words.get(1)) : null;
599                if (n == null) {
600                    io.out().println("The format of the command is: 'I <integer?>'");
601                    return true;
602                }
603                increaseGlobalScope(io, n);
604            }
605            case "s", "setScope" -> {
606                Integer n = arity == 2 ? natural(words.get(2)) : null;
607                if (n == null) {
608                    io.out().println("The format of the command is: 's <claferUID> <integer>'");
609                    return true;
610                }
611                setScopes(io, words.get(1), sig -> n);
612            }
613            case "i", "incScope" -> {
614                Integer n = arity == 1 ? Integer.valueOf(1) : arity == 2 ? integer(words.get(2)) : null;
615                if (n == null) {
616                    io.out().println("The format of the command is: 'i <claferUID> <integer?>'");
617                    return true;
618                }
619                setScopes(io, words.get(1), sig -> Math.max(1, valueOfScope(sig) + n));
620            }
621            case "b", "bitwidth" -> {
622                Integer n = arity == 1 ? natural(words.get(1)) : null;
623                if (n == null) {
624                    io.out().println("The format of the command is: 'b <integer>'");
625                    return true;
626                }
627                if (n >= 4) {
628                    setBitwidth(n);
629                    printBitwidthWarning(io, n);
630                    solve();
631                    printBitwidthIntRange(io, n);
632                }
633            }
634            case "m", "maxInt", "maxint" -> {
635                Integer n = arity == 1 ? natural(words.get(1)) : null;
636                if (n == null) {
637                    io.out().println("The format of the command is: 'm <integer>'");
638                    return true;
639                }
640                if (n >= 7) {
641                    int bw = requiredBitwidth(n);
642                    setBitwidth(bw);
643                    printBitwidthWarning(io, bw);
644                    solve();
645                    printBitwidthIntRange(io, bw);
646                }
647            }
648            case "tl" -> {
649                Integer n = arity == 1 ? natural(words.get(1)) : null;
650                if (n == null) {
651                    io.out().println("The format of the command is: 'tl <integer>'");
652                    return true;
653                }
654                if (!dynamic) {
655                    io.out().println("The model is static: its instances are not traces.");
656                } else if (n < 1) {
657                    io.out().println("The trace length must be at least 1.");
658                } else {
659                    session.setMaxTraceLength(n);
660                    solve();
661                    io.out().println("The maximum trace length is " + n + ".");
662                }
663            }
664            case "r", "reload" -> reload(io);
665            case "scope" -> showScopes(io);
666            case "v", "saveScopes" -> {
667                saveScopes();
668                io.out().println("Scopes saved to the `.cfr-scope` file.");
669            }
670            case "loadScopes" -> loadScopes(io);
671            case "a", "alloyModel" -> io.out().println(editAlloyModel());
672            case "c", "claferModel" -> showClaferModel(io);
673            case "setUnsatCoreMinimization" -> {
674                Integer level = arity != 1 ? null : switch (words.get(1)) {
675                    case "fastest" -> 2;
676                    case "medium" -> 1;
677                    case "best" -> 0;
678                    default -> null;
679                };
680                if (level == null) {
681                    io.out().println("The format of the command is: 'setUnsatCoreMinimization <fastest|medium|best>'");
682                    return true;
683                }
684                session.setUnsatCoreMinimization(level);
685                solve();
686            }
687            case "u", "unsatCore" -> {
688                // clafersg's header, with the constraints of claferIG's unsat core, as 'n' lists them
689                io.out().println("UNSAT Core command:");
690                List<Constraint> core = present(findRemovable(session.unsatCore()));
691                if (core.isEmpty()) {
692                    io.out().println("No unsat core: the model has a solution within " + (dynamic
693                            ? "the scopes and the maximum trace length." : "the scopes."));
694                }
695                int i = 1;
696                for (Constraint c : core) {
697                    io.out().println("  " + i++ + ") " + printConstraint(c));
698                }
699            }
700            case "U", "minUnsat", "p", "prettify", "x", "maximize", "z", "minimize", "t", "stats",
701                    "O", "Options", "g", "strategy", "o", "optimizations", "B", "symmetryBreaking" ->
702                io.out().println("The command '" + name + "' is for static models, which Choco solves.");
703            default -> {
704                return false;
705            }
706        }
707        return true;
708    }
709
710    private void setGlobalScopeCommand(Repl.Io io, int value) throws Err {
711        int newGlobalScope = Math.max(1, value);
712        setGlobalScope(newGlobalScope);
713        if (newGlobalScope > allowedMaxInt(bitwidth)) {
714            io.out().println("Warning! Requested global scope is larger than maximum allowed by bitwidth ... increasing bitwidth");
715            setBitwidth(requiredBitwidth(newGlobalScope));
716            printBitwidthWarning(io, bitwidth);
717        }
718        solve();
719        io.out().println("Global scope set to " + newGlobalScope);
720    }
721
722    private void increaseGlobalScope(Repl.Io io, int inc) throws Err {
723        int bw = bitwidth;
724        int newGlobalScope = Math.max(1, globalScope + inc);
725        setGlobalScope(newGlobalScope);
726        if (newGlobalScope > allowedMaxInt(bw)) {
727            io.out().println("Warning! Requested global scope is larger than maximum allowed by bitwidth ... increasing bitwidth");
728            setBitwidth(requiredBitwidth(newGlobalScope));
729            printBitwidthWarning(io, bitwidth);
730        }
731        // the clafers without instances keep their scopes, 0
732        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> s : new ArrayList<>(scopes.entrySet())) {
733            if (!hasNoInstances(s.getKey())) {
734                setAlloyScopeAndBitwidth(io, bw, Math.max(1, s.getValue() + inc), claferNameOfSig(s.getKey()),
735                        s.getKey());
736            }
737        }
738        solve();
739        io.out().println("Global scope changed to " + newGlobalScope);
740    }
741
742    @FunctionalInterface
743    private interface ScopeOf {
744
745        int of(String sig);
746    }
747
748    private void setScopes(Repl.Io io, String qName, ScopeOf value) throws Err {
749        int bw = bitwidth;
750        for (String uid : getUIDs(qName)) {
751            String sig = sigOfUID(uid);
752            if (!sigMap.containsKey(sig)) {
753                continue;
754            }
755            // the compiler's setAlloyScopeAndBitwidth ignores a subset sig, whose scope is not set
756            setAlloyScopeAndBitwidth(io, bw, value.of(sig), qName, sig);
757        }
758        solve();
759    }
760
761    private Optional<String> setAlloyScopeAndBitwidth(Repl.Io io, int bw, int newValue, String fqName, String sig)
762            throws Err {
763        if (hasNoInstances(sig)) {
764            io.out().println("Scope of " + fqName + " (" + sig.substring(5) + ") stays 0: it has no instances, since no"
765                    + " concrete clafer inherits from it or from the abstract clafer it is in");
766            return Optional.empty();
767        }
768        if (newValue > allowedMaxInt(bw)) {
769            setBitwidth(requiredBitwidth(newValue));
770            io.out().println("Warning! Requested scope for " + fqName + " is larger than maximum allowed by bitwidth"
771                    + " ... increasing bitwidth");
772            printBitwidthWarning(io, bitwidth);
773        }
774        Optional<String> subset = setAlloyScope(newValue, sig);
775        io.out().println("Scope of " + fqName + " (" + sig.substring(5) + ") changed to " + newValue);
776        return subset;
777    }

779    private void showScopes(Repl.Io io) {
780        io.out().println("Global scope = " + globalScope);
781        scopes.forEach((sig, value) -> io.out().println("  " + uidOfSig(sig) + " scope = " + value));
782    }

784    private Path scopeFile() {
785        return Path.of(modelFileName + "-scope");
786    }
787
788    private void saveScopes() throws IOException {
789        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("[\n");
790        List<String> entries = new ArrayList<>();
791        entries.add("{\"lpqName\": \"\", \"scope\": " + globalScope + "}");
792        scopes.forEach((sig, value) -> entries.add("{\"lpqName\": \"" + uidOfSig(sig) + "\", \"scope\": " + value
793                + "}"));
794        sb.append(String.join(",\n", entries)).append("\n]\n");
795        Files.writeString(scopeFile(), sb.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
796    }

798    private void loadScopes(Repl.Io io) throws Exception {
799        if (!Files.isRegularFile(scopeFile())) {
800            io.out().println("The `.cfr-scope` file does not exist. Use the command `saveScopes` to create one.");
801            return;
802        }
803        Map<String, Integer> read = readScopeFile(Files.readString(scopeFile(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
804        Integer global = null;
805        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : read.entrySet()) {
806            if (e.getKey().isEmpty()) {
807                global = global == null ? e.getValue() : Math.max(global, e.getValue());
808            }
809        }
810        // a file may list only some clafers, without the global scope; then it stays
811        if (global != null) {
812            setGlobalScope(global);
813        }
814        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : read.entrySet()) {
815            if (!e.getKey().isEmpty()) {
816                for (String uid : getUIDs(e.getKey())) {
817                    String sig = sigOfUID(uid);
818                    if (sigMap.containsKey(sig)) {
819                        setAlloyScope(e.getValue(), sig);
820                    }
821                }
822            }
823        }
824        io.out().println("Scopes loaded from the `.cfr-scope` file.");
825        showScopes(io);
826    }
827
828    // the {"lpqName": ..., "scope": ...} entries of a .cfr-scope file
829    private static Map<String, Integer> readScopeFile(String text) {
830        Map<String, Integer> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
831        java.util.regex.Matcher m = java.util.regex.Pattern
832                .compile("\\{\\s*\"lpqName\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]*)\"\\s*,\\s*\"scope\"\\s*:\\s*(-?\\d+)\\s*\\}")
833                .matcher(text);
834        while (m.find()) {
835            out.put(m.group(1), Integer.parseInt(m.group(2)));
836        }
837        return out;
838    }
839
840    private void reload(Repl.Io io) throws Exception {
841        Map<String, Integer> oldScopes = new TreeMap<>(scopes);
842        int oldBw = bitwidth;
843        int oldGlobal = globalScope;
844        try {
845            load();
846            setGlobalScope(oldGlobal);
847        } catch (Exception e) {
848            io.err().println(e.getMessage());
849        }
850        // mergeScopes: the larger of the old and the new scope of each clafer
851        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> s : new ArrayList<>(scopes.entrySet())) {
852            int old = oldScopes.getOrDefault(s.getKey(), s.getValue());
853            setAlloyScope(Math.max(s.getValue(), old), s.getKey());
854        }
855        setBitwidth(findNecessaryBitwidth(oldBw, new ArrayList<>(scopes.values())));
856        printBitwidthWarning(io, bitwidth);
857        solve();
858    }

860    /**
861     * {@code c}: the Clafer model, each line with its number in its file,
862     * the lines of the unsat core marked, and the scope of the clafer
863     * declared on the line, as claferIG's {@code ShowClaferModel}.
864     */
865    private void showClaferModel(Repl.Io io) {
866        printBitwidthIntRange(io, bitwidth);
867        io.out().println("Global scope  = " + globalScope + "\n");
868        // the constraints of the unsat core: a constraint on the line where it starts, a cardinality by its text
869        List<Integer> unsatLines = new ArrayList<>();
870        List<String> unsatTexts = new ArrayList<>();
871        for (Constraint c : present(findRemovable(session.unsatCore()))) {
872            switch (c) {
873                case UserConstraint u -> unsatLines.add(u.constraintInfo().pos().line());
874                case ExactCardinalityConstraint e -> unsatTexts.add(e.claferInfo().toString());
875                case LowerCardinalityConstraint l -> unsatTexts.add(l.claferInfo().toString());
876                case UpperCardinalityConstraint u -> unsatTexts.add(u.claferInfo().toString());
877            }
878        }
879        String text = ir.files().text();
880        // the lines of the comments
881        Set<Integer> commentLines = new HashSet<>();
882        for (org.clafer.frontend.Token t : org.clafer.frontend.ClaferLexer.lex(text).others()) {
883            if (t.kind() == org.clafer.frontend.TokenKind.COMMENT) {
884                for (int l = t.span().line(); l <= t.span().endLine(); l++) {
885                    commentLines.add(l);
886                }
887            }
888        }
889        // the clafer declared on each line, by its Alloy name: of two on a line, the smaller UID
890        Map<Integer, String> lineNumMap = new HashMap<>();
891        Map<Integer, String> lineUids = new HashMap<>();
892        for (ClaferSymbol c : ir.names().clafers()) {
893            int line = c.declaration().span().line();
894            String other = lineUids.get(line);
895            if (other == null || c.uid().compareTo(other) < 0) {
896                lineUids.put(line, c.uid());
897                lineNumMap.put(line, alloyName(c.uid()));
898            }
899        }
900        List<String> claferLines = lines(removeCommentsAndUnify(text));
901        int maxLineLength = claferLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
902        int digits = Integer.toString(claferLines.size()).length();
903        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
904        String previousPath = null;
905        for (int num = 1; num <= claferLines.size(); num++) {
906            String l = claferLines.get(num - 1);
907            if (commentLines.contains(num) && isEmptyLine(l)) {
908                continue;
909            }
910            var position = ir.files().position(num);
911            if (!position.path().equals(previousPath)) {
912                sb.append("--- ").append(position.path()).append('\n');
913                previousPath = position.path();
914            }
915            boolean unsat = isUnsat(unsatLines, unsatTexts, l, num);
916            String fileNum = Integer.toString(position.line());
917            sb.append(fileNum).append('.').append(" ".repeat(Math.max(0, 1 + digits - fileNum.length())))
918                    .append(unsat ? "> " : "| ").append(l).append(" ".repeat(3 + maxLineLength - l.length()))
919                    .append(unsat ? "<UnSAT " : "|      ");
920            String clafer = lineNumMap.get(num);
921            if (clafer != null) {
922                Integer scope = scopes.get("this/" + clafer);
923                sb.append("scope = ").append(scope == null ? "Nothing" : scope);
924            }
925            sb.append('\n');
926        }
927        io.out().println(sb);
928    }
929
930    // a constraint is on the line where it starts; a cardinality is on the line with the clafer's name and
931    // cardinality
932    private static boolean isUnsat(List<Integer> unsatLines, List<String> unsatTexts, String l, int num) {
933        if (unsatLines.contains(num)) {
934            return true;
935        }
936        List<String> lw = words(l);
937        for (String u : unsatTexts) {
938            List<String> uw = words(u);
939            String uFirst = uw.isEmpty() ? "" : uw.get(0);
940            String lFirst = lw.isEmpty() ? "" : lw.get(0);
941            String uLast = uw.isEmpty() ? "" : uw.get(uw.size() - 1);
942            String lLast = lw.isEmpty() ? "" : lw.get(lw.size() - 1);
943            if ((uFirst.equals(lFirst) && uLast.equals(lLast)) || l.contains(u)) {
944                return true;
945            }
946        }
947        return false;
948    }
949
950    private static List<String> words(String s) {
951        String t = s.strip();
952        return t.isEmpty() ? List.of() : List.of(t.split("\\s+"));
953    }
954
955    private String editAlloyModel() {
956        String model = translation.code();
957        List<String> alloyLines = lines(removeCommentsAndUnify(model));
958        int splitNum = 1;
959        while (splitNum - 1 < alloyLines.size() && !isEmptyLine(alloyLines.get(splitNum - 1))) {
960            splitNum++;
961        }
962        List<String> info = alloyLines.subList(0, Math.min(splitNum, alloyLines.size()));
963        List<String> rest = alloyLines.subList(Math.min(splitNum, alloyLines.size()), alloyLines.size());
964        int m = rest.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
965        int digits = Integer.toString(alloyLines.size()).length();
966        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("global scope = " + globalScope + "\n\n");
967        info.forEach(l -> sb.append(l).append('\n'));
968        int num = 1 + splitNum;
969        for (String l : rest) {
970            String withScope;
971            String pad = " ".repeat(3 + m - l.length());
972            if (!List.of(l.trim().split("\\s+")).contains("sig")) {
973                withScope = l + pad + " |";
974            } else {
975                int us = l.indexOf('_');
976                String key = us < 0 ? "" : l.substring(us + 1).split("[ \t\n]", 2)[0];
977                Integer val = scopes.get(key);
978                withScope = l + pad + " | scope = " + (val == null ? "Nothing" : val);
979            }
980            sb.append(num).append('.').append(" ".repeat(1 + digits - Integer.toString(num).length())).append("| ")
981                    .append(withScope).append('\n');
982            num++;
983        }
984        return sb.toString();
985    }
986
987    private static List<String> lines(String s) {
988        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
989        int start = 0;
990        while (start < s.length()) {
991            int end = s.indexOf('\n', start);
992            if (end < 0) {
993                out.add(s.substring(start));
994                break;
995            }
996            out.add(s.substring(start, end));
997            start = end + 1;
998        }
999        return out;
1000    }
1001
1002    private static boolean isEmptyLine(String l) {
1003        return l.chars().allMatch(c -> c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\t' || c == '\r');
1004    }
1005
1006    // only remove the contents while preserving the empty lines
1007    private static String removeCommentsAndUnify(String model) {
1008        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
1009        int i = 0;
1010        int n = model.length();
1011        while (i < n) {
1012            if (i == n - 1) {
1013                sb.append(model.charAt(i));
1014                break;
1015            }
1016            char c = model.charAt(i);
1017            if (c == '\t') {
1018                sb.append("   ");
1019                i++;
1020            } else if (c == '/' && model.charAt(i + 1) == '/') {
1021                while (i < n && model.charAt(i) != '\n') {
1022                    i++;
1023                }
1024            } else if (c == '/' && model.charAt(i + 1) == '*') {
1025                i += 2;
1026                while (i < n) {
1027                    if (i == n - 1) {
1028                        i = n;
1029                        break;
1030                    }
1031                    if (model.charAt(i) == '\n') {
1032                        sb.append('\n');
1033                        i++;
1034                    } else if (model.charAt(i) == '*' && model.charAt(i + 1) == '/') {
1035                        i += 2;
1036                        break;
1037                    } else {
1038                        i++;
1039                    }
1040                }
1041            } else {
1042                sb.append(c);
1043                i++;
1044            }
1045        }
1046        return sb.toString();
1047    }

1054                                           of a dynamic model, or to output a message that no more solutions exist within
1055                                           the given scope
1056                'S'etGlobalScope <n>     - to set the global scope to <n>
1057                'I'ncGlobalScope <n?>    - to increase the global scope by <n>, 1 by default
1058                's'etScope <name> <n>    - to set the scope of the clafer <name> to <n>
1059                'i'ncScope <name> <n?>   - to increase the scope of the clafer <name> by <n>, 1 by default
1060                'm'axInt, 'maxint' <n>   - to set the bitwidth by providing the largest integer
1061                'b'itwidth <n>           - to set the bitwidth
1062                'tl' <n>                 - to set the maximum length of the traces of a dynamic model
1063                'd'iff                   - to show each next instance or state as its changes from the previous one, or in full
1064                                           (+ appears, - disappears, ~ changes its value)
1065                'fork' <n>               - to produce another trace with the states of the last trace before state <n>
1066                'config'                 - to produce a trace of a dynamic model whose clafers that do not change over time
1067                                           differ from those of the traces so far
1068                'check' <n?>             - to check the assertions of the model within the scopes and the maximum trace
1069                                           length, and to give a counterexample of each one that fails; with <n>, only

1071                sav'e'                   - to save all solutions displayed so far to files named
1072                                           <model file name>.<solution number>.data, one solution per file
1073                'dot'                    - to save the most recent solution as a Graphviz graph, for a trace its states
1074                                           and transitions, to <model file name>.<solution number>.dot
1075                'q'uit                   - to quit the interactive session
1076                'r'eload                 - to reload your clafer model
1077                'h'elp                   - to display this menu options summary
1078                'scope'                  - to print out the values of the global scope and individual Clafer scopes
1079                sa'v'eScopes             - to generate a '<model>.cfr-scope' file with the current scopes

1082                'u'nsatCore              - to print out the constraints of the unsat core of the model, if it has no solution

1086                'f'ind <name>            - to print a Clafer with given name found in the most recent solution
